description: This file defines the Customer model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, including methods for managing customer data such as add, edit, delete, and retrieval operations, as well as handling customer authentication tokens and related activities.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Model class for customer data management in Opencart, providing methods for CRUD operations, authentication, and related activities.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer record identified by customer_id.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a customer identified by email.

methods.name: editNewsletter
methods.description: Updates the newsletter subscription status for a customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer and associated data such as activities, addresses, and orders.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves customer data by customer_id.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves customer data by email address.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByEmail
methods.description: Returns the count of customers with a specific email.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes customer history records.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Deletes customer IP records.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves IP records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Counts IP records for a customer.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Logs a customer login with IP and country info.

methods.name: addLoginAttempt
methods.description: Records a login attempt for a customer email.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Removes login attempt records for an email.

methods.name: getLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves login attempt data for an email.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Creates a new authorization record for a customer.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a customer authorization.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Updates the total attempts for a customer authorization.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes customer authorization records.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Deletes a customer authorization record by token.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Retrieves authorization data by token.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets total attempts for a customer.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Creates a new token record for a customer.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Deletes a token record by code.

methods.name: getTokenByCode
methods.description: Retrieves token data by code.
